content: {"episode_id":"ep-05058","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"This appeal addresses the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, for episode ep-05058. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope (R55), raising concern for intermittent arrhythmia. Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73), prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptoms with potential cardiac rhythm disturbances. This documentation is submitted as the supporting clinical documentation described in the payer letter for CPT 93229."}
